steps.step: On arrival, confirm the appliance is the microwave shown in the call before starting any work.
Before touching anything, unplug the microwave and recheck for water, damaged wiring, scorch marks, and poor light.
Ask the caller to confirm it heats but the turntable will not spin, as reported on the call.
Open the cavity and verify the roller ring and hub coupler are present and the glass tray is missing.
Check hub coupler and roller ring movement by hand, then test powered spin only with a fitting tray placed.
Have hub and motor parts ready for the booked repair, but verify fit and need on site before installing.
Measure for a replacement glass tray and confirm size on site; do not rely on the faucet kit listed.

gaps: Model number and age of the microwave were not in the evidence.
Exact cause of the turntable not spinning was not established.
No meter reading or powered motor test was done on the call.
Heating was only reported by the caller and was not independently verified.
